title: Apply for a NSW Photo Card
summary: Learn about and apply for a NSW Photo Card to prove your identity if you do not have a NSW Driver Licence.
intro:
If you do not have photo identification such as a NSW Driver Licence, you can use a NSW Photo Card to prove your identity in most places a driver licence is recognised.

You cannot use a NSW Photo Card as identification or in place of a NSW Driver Licence in certain situations, including some online applications. Always check the proof of identity requirements for details.

The Photo Card has the same security features as the NSW Driver Licence and shows your name, address, date of birth and photo. It is valid for 5 years (or 10 years for eligible customers aged 21 and over).

Getting a Photo Card is voluntary. It has the same application process as a NSW Driver Licence.

Visit a Service NSW Centre and apply in person for your Photo Card.
who_can_apply: Must be able to provide acceptable proof of identity documents

faqs.q: What is a NSW Photo Card?
faqs.a: The NSW Photo Card is an alternative form of identification that can be used in most places where a driver licence is recognized. It shows your name, address, date of birth, and photo.

faqs.q: Can I use a NSW Photo Card instead of a NSW Driver Licence?
faqs.a: You can use it in most places a driver licence is recognized, but you cannot use it in certain situations, including some online applications.

faqs.q: How long is a NSW Photo Card valid for?
faqs.a: It is valid for 5 years, or 10 years for eligible customers aged 21 and over.
